generation.mode: built-in imagegen edit with the edit target first and the canon second as reference only

lightingIsotropy.metric: 36-bin land-luminance-gradient magnitude peak divided by uniform-bin mean; water-mask pixels and gradients below 12 luminance units excluded
lightingIsotropy.visualCheck: The aggregate directional signal is low, but inspection still finds bright rock tops, darker terrace faces, and dark value beneath several conifer crowns. The literal same-value-on-every-side and no-contact-shadow rule is not established.

buildableVsSteepFraction.basis: manual visual estimate of non-water land area
buildableVsSteepFraction.method: The broad central shelf, open southern bench, and clear meadow runs count as buildable; exposed terrace faces count as steep; dense stands, talus, and the rocky eastern transition make up the remainder.

crown.method: All 63 dark-green conifer crown components found by the full-canvas census, including every sapling-sized component, were measured at source scale and converted by 2560/1254 at 0.048 m per final pixel.

waterMask.encoding: opaque white water pixels on fully transparent non-water pixels; binary alpha
waterMask.derivation: A continuous bank-to-bank manual trace for the north feeder, irregular pool, south outlet, and west stream was unioned with a source-colour wet-paint classification constrained to those traced corridors; enclosed wet-surface holes were filled.
